detail.longDescription:
GitHub tells you what is trending. CopoHub tells you why it matters.

Most GitHub clients stop at the list you can already open in a browser. CopoHub adds the missing layer: every repository on GitHub Trending gets a one-line summary, a six-dimension score and its trending history, so you can judge a project in seconds instead of opening it and guessing.

WHY DEVELOPERS PICK COPOHUB
- One-line summaries for every trending repo: what it actually does, not the maintainer's slogan. 1,200+ repositories covered.
- Six-dimension score: pain point, clarity, value, 30-day momentum, activity and freshness, 0-10 each, drawn as a radar chart.
- Trending record: appearances, best rank, daily streak, stars gained while trending, plus a 180-day ranking timeline.
- Star with a reason: save why you starred a repository and group your stars, so months later the list still makes sense.
- Deep dives on trending projects: tech stack, core features and real use cases.
- Daily GitHub brief, language trends, curated open-source picks and a watchlist.

A FULL GITHUB CLIENT
Browse repositories, stars, organizations, followers, notifications, issues, pull requests, commits, releases, files and READMEs. Review PR summaries and code changes in a mobile layout. Create repositories, issues, pull requests and branches where GitHub supports it. Sign in with GitHub OAuth or a personal access token. Light and dark themes, local cache controls, daily reminders and shareable report cards.

CopoHub is free to use. Pro adds the 180-day ranking timeline and unlimited deep dives.

CopoHub uses the official GitHub API. It is an independent third-party app and is not affiliated with GitHub, Inc.
